user: Hey, I need help planning the HacLab open house. It's Saturday October 24th. Can you keep track of details as we go?
We got Herak 218 for the room. It fits about 60 people. Doors open at 10am and we wrap by 2.
Budget is $1,850 total from the department. That has to cover food, printing, and swag.
Our guest speaker is Dr. Priya Raman from WSU. She's talking about GPU clusters for undergrads. Give me three possible talk titles.
Food: 12 pizzas from Flying Goat. One thing to remember, Marcus on the student team is vegan, so at least two need to be vegan.
Swag: 40 t-shirts from Spokane Print Co. Any ideas for a short slogan that fits on a shirt?
Logistics note for whoever sets up: the projector in that room only takes HDMI 1, port 2 is dead. Also the parking code for the lot is BULLDOG24.
The live demo is the GPU wall dashboard on the big screen. Can you write two sentences introducing it for the program?
Flyers must be at the print shop by October 9th to make it back in time. Draft the flyer text, keep it under 60 words.
Ok, that's the plan so far. Let's keep going.
Draft a short welcome email to the student volunteers with the date, room, and start time, and ask them to arrive an hour early.
Make a simple schedule for the day from doors open to wrap-up: welcome, guest talk, live demo, pizza, open lab time.
Write a two-sentence social media post announcing the open house.
List the volunteer roles we need and one sentence describing each.
Draft a thank-you note we can send Dr. Raman afterwards.
Give me a packing list for the setup crew: cables, signage, tape, that kind of thing.
Write three trivia questions about GPUs we could use as icebreakers.
Suggest a simple way to count attendance without making people sign in.
Draft the 30-second intro the host reads before the guest talk.
Ok, that's all the prep work. Now let's double-check the details.
Remind me, what date is the open house and what time do doors open?
Which room did we get?
What's the total budget again? And roughly split it across food, printing, and swag.
Who is the guest speaker and where is she from?
Write the food order as a one-line message to the restaurant. Include the dietary thing.
What do I need to tell the AV setup person about the projector?
What's the parking code, and how many shirts did we order and from whom?
What is the live demo, in one sentence?
When do the flyers have to be at the print shop?
Give me a final checklist with every concrete detail we settled: date, time, room, budget, speaker, food, shirts, projector, parking, demo, flyer deadline.
